title: The Sealed Vault
text: A vault door of black iron is set in the rock, carved with a House's crest that is not yours and sealed in red wax a century old. Scratches cover the inside of the frame, where something tried to get out.

options.label: Break the old seal; whatever tried to get out is long dead.

outcomes.text: There is old wealth inside, and nothing else.

options.label: The wisest reads the crest to learn whose House sealed it.

outcomes.text: It belonged to a House that fell. Its secrets are worth more than its gold.

options.label: Leave it sealed; something wanted out of there badly.

outcomes.text: The crest stays in the Leader's mind. When they meet that House again, they will know a thing about them.

options.label: The Vagabond lifts the wax without breaking it, so no one will know it was opened.

outcomes.text: They are in and out, the seal looking as it did. Inside were old money and older letters, and the letters are worth more.
The vault was sealed for a reason. Something has waited a century to get out.
